title: Common flat-tower refinement of a homotopy morphism
statement: Let Y be a scheme, let H be the homotopy category of cochain complexes of its module sheaves [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], and let Ctel be the flat-telescope shift representatives [def-sc-flat-telescope-stage-map]. For X,Xprime in Ctel and any s:X→Xprime there exist R in Ctel and a:R→X, b:R→Xprime such that a is a quasi-isomorphism [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules], both a and b are stage-induced maps [def-sc-flat-telescope-stage-map], and a;s=b in H. This is a statement solely about tower presentations and refinement; no derived pullback or normalized comparison occurs.

source.place: Parent lem-sc-normalized-flat-telescope-comparison, steps 1–3; Tags 06YS and 06YJ for flat models. The explicit stage-map refinement and supplied-tensorator normalization are agent expansions, not literal Stacks assertions.

proof.text: Lift the homotopy map to a cochain map between the indicated (possibly translated) telescope models. Resolve its arrow diagram using flat covers of the bounded-above truncations and compatible-pair lifts. At successive stages retain the preceding commutative square. Mapping cylinders rectify the homotopies of the transition squares; their terms are finite sums of flat terms and stay bounded above. Diagonalize the countable stages, using larger stages to accommodate the finite supports of sections in the coproducts.

Take the transition cones of the resulting sum maps. This gives two stage-induced maps from a common flat telescope. The augmentation to the source is a quasi-isomorphism by the flat truncation telescope comparison. If the squares initially agree only after localization, right-fraction equality supplies a further source refinement on which they agree in the homotopy category; repeat the compatible flat diagram construction for this source. Composition of the tower maps and quasi-isomorphisms gives a;s=b. Translate and transport the diagrams by the original homotopy isomorphisms. Zero and identity arrow diagrams give the corresponding edge cases.

proof_origin.place: Explicit split of the parent model construction and common-replacement argument.

lean.statement: theorem exists_flat_telescope_stage_map_refinement (Y : Scheme.{u}) {X X' : HomotopyCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)} (hX : flatTelescopeShiftRepresentative Y X) (hX' : flatTelescopeShiftRepresentative Y X') (s : X ⟶ X') : ∃ (R : HomotopyCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) (a : R ⟶ X) (b : R ⟶ X'), flatTelescopeShiftRepresentative Y R ∧ HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) a ∧ flatTelescopeStageMap Y a ∧ flatTelescopeStageMap Y b ∧ a ≫ s = b
